items.source: Configures whether the MappingContext is in strict mode which means, that it will throw MappingExceptions in case one tries to lookup a PersistentEntity not already in the context.
items.translation: 配置是否将MappingContext设置为严格模式，这意味着如果尝试查找上下文中尚未存在的PersistentEntity，将抛出MappingException。

items.source: Configures whether the MappingContext is in strict mode which means, that it will throw MappingExceptions in case one tries to lookup a PersistentEntity not already in the context. This defaults to false so that unknown types will be transparently added to the MappingContext if not known in advance.
items.translation: 配置是否将 MappingContext 设置为严格模式，这意味着如果尝试查找上下文中尚未存在的 PersistentEntity，将会抛出 MappingException。此属性的默认值为 false，因此如果无法预先知晓类型，未知的类型将被透明地添加到 MappingContext 中。

items.source: Returns a PersistentEntity for the given Class. Will return null for types that are considered simple ones.
items.translation: 返回给定PersistentEntity的实例，该实例对应于指定的Class。对于被视为简单类型的情况，将返回null。

items.source: Returns a PersistentEntity for the given TypeInformation. Will return null for types that are considered simple ones.

items.source: Sets the application context. Sets also ApplicationEventPublisher and Environment if these weren't already set.
items.translation: 设置应用程序上下文。如果尚未设置，还会同时设置 ApplicationEventPublisher 和 Environment。

items.source: Configures the SimpleTypeHolder to be used by the MappingContext. Allows customization of what types will be regarded as simple types and thus not recursively analyzed.
items.translation: 配置SimpleTypeHolder供MappingContext使用。允许自定义哪些类型将被视为简单类型，从而不进行递归分析。

items.source: Returns all PersistentPropertyPaths pointing to properties on the given type that match the given Predicate. In case of circular references the detection will stop at the property that references a type that's already included in the path. Note, that is a potentially expensive operation as results cannot be cached.
items.translation: 返回所有指向给定类型上属性且匹配给定Predicate的PersistentPropertyPath。在存在循环引用的情况下，检测将在引用已包含在路径中的类型的属性处停止。请注意，这是一个潜在昂贵的操作，因为结果无法缓存。

items.source: Actually looks up the PersistentPropertyPaths for the given type, selection predicate and traversal guard. Primary purpose is to allow subtypes to alter the default traversal guard, e.g. used by findPersistentPropertyPaths(Class, Predicate).
items.translation: 实际上，它会为给定的类型、选择谓词和遍历守卫查找 PersistentPropertyPaths。其主要目的是允许子类型修改默认的遍历守卫，例如由 findPersistentPropertyPaths(Class, Predicate) 使用。

items.source: Returns whether a PersistentEntity instance should be created for the given TypeInformation. By default, this will reject all types considered simple and non-supported Kotlin classes, but it might be necessary to tweak that in case you have registered custom converters for top level types (which renders them to be considered simple) but still need meta-information about them.
items.translation: 返回是否应为给定的 TypeInformation 创建 PersistentEntity 实例。默认情况下，此方法会拒绝所有被视为简单且不受支持的 Kotlin 类，但在您已为顶层类型注册了自定义转换器（使其被视为简单类型）但仍需要其元信息的情况下，可能需要对此进行调整。

items.source: the PersistentEntity mapped by the given PersistentProperty or null if no PersistentEntity exists for it or the PersistentProperty does not refer to an entity (the type of the property is considered simple see SimpleTypeHolder.isSimpleType(Class)).
items.translation: 由给定PersistentProperty映射的PersistentEntity，或者如果不存在对应的PersistentEntity或该PersistentProperty不引用实体（即属性类型被视为简单类型，参见 SimpleTypeHolder.isSimpleType(Class)），则为 null。

items.source: E - the concrete PersistentEntity type the MappingContext implementation creates
items.translation: E - 由 PersistentEntity 接口的具体类型，该类型是 MappingContext 实现所创建的

items.source: P - the concrete PersistentProperty type the MappingContext implementation creates
items.translation: P - 由 PersistentProperty 接口实现的 MappingContext 创建的具体类型

items.source: all TypeInformations for the PersistentEntitys in the MappingContext.
items.translation: 所有在TypeInformation接口中的PersistentEntity的MappingContext。

items.translation: 如果未找到与PersistentEntity关联的TypeInformation，则返回 null。

items.source: managedTypes - must not be null. Use ManagedTypes.empty() instead.
items.translation: managedTypes - 不能为 null。请使用 ManagedTypes.empty()。

items.source: environment - the Environment that this component runs in.
items.translation: environment - 该组件运行的 Environment。

items.source: null if no PersistentEntity found for type.
items.translation: 如果该类型未找到对应的PersistentEntity，则返回 null。

items.source: true if PersistentEntity present for given type.
items.translation: 如果给定类型存在PersistentEntity，则返回 true。

items.source: applicationContext - the ApplicationContext object to be used by this object.
items.translation: applicationContext - 此对象将使用的 ApplicationContext 对象。

items.source: beanFactory - owning BeanFactory.
items.translation: beanFactory - 拥有该 BeanFactory。

items.source: simpleTypes - must not be null.
items.translation: simpleTypes 不得为 null。

items.source: persistentProperty - must not be null.
items.translation: <persistentProperty> 不得为 null。

items.source: predicate - must not be null.
items.translation: <predicate> - 不能为 null。

items.source: predicate - will never be null.
items.translation: - 永远不会为 null。

items.source: traversalGuard - will never be null.
items.translation: traversalGuard 永远不会为 null。

items.source: Base class to build mapping metadata and thus create instances of PersistentEntity and PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 用于构建映射元数据的基础类，从而创建 PersistentEntity 和 PersistentProperty 的实例。
